## GEOGRAPHY component boundaries
# Source: third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions.md
# Closed lines have empty boundaries, as documented by ST_ISCLOSED.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions.md

SELECT ST_BOUNDARY(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

SELECT TYPEOF(ST_BOUNDARY(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2)))
=> "GEOGRAPHY"

SELECT ST_BOUNDARY(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_BOUNDARY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 1 1)'))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_BOUNDARY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_BOUNDARY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1, 2 0)')), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 2 0)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_BOUNDARY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 0 1, 0 0)'))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_BOUNDARY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 4 0, 0 4, 0 0))')), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 4 0, 0 4, 0 0)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_BOUNDARY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 10 0, 0 10, 0 0), (1 1, 1 2, 2 1, 1 1))')), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTILINESTRING((0 0, 10 0, 0 10, 0 0), (1 1, 1 2, 2 1, 1 1))'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_BOUNDARY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOLYGON(((0 0, 2 0, 0 2, 0 0)), ((10 0, 12 0, 10 2, 10 0)))')), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTILINESTRING((0 0, 2 0, 0 2, 0 0), (10 0, 12 0, 10 2, 10 0))'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_BOUNDARY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POINT(9 9), LINESTRING(10 0, 12 0), POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 0 2, 0 0)))')), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(MULTIPOINT(10 0, 12 0), LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0, 0 2, 0 0))'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_BOUNDARY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_BOUNDARY(ST_MAKEPOLYGON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING EMPTY'), [ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0, 0 2, 0 0)')])), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0, 0 2, 0 0)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_BOUNDARY(SAFE.ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 100))
=> null

SELECT ST_EQUALS(SAFE.ST_BOUNDARY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)')), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 2 0)'))
=> "true"

# Source: BigQuery answers collected by the maintainer.
SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_BOUNDARY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTILINESTRING((0 0, 1 0), (1 0, 2 0))')), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 1 0, 2 0)'))
=> "false"
